rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial word for a girl or young woman.

example.jyutping: go2 go3 neoi5 zai2 hou2 sik1 gong2 siu3

rows.note: Use this when you want to make clear that the girl is a child.

example.english: That little girl is playing in the park.
example.traditional: 嗰個細路女喺公園玩緊。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 sai3 lou6 neoi5 hai2 gung1 jyun4 waan2 gan2

rows.note: Use this specifically for someone’s girlfriend rather than just any girl or young woman.

example.english: They finally introduced their girl to us.
example.traditional: 佢終於帶女朋友嚟見我哋。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zung1 jyu1 daai3 neoi5 pang4 jau5 lei4 gin3 ngo5 dei6

rows.note: Use this as a friendly or service-style address to a young woman, with an implication that she is attractive.

example.english: Girl, please take a seat over here.
example.jyutping: leng3 neoi5 ni1 bin1 co5 aa3
